title_zh: 苹果确认 10 月 28 日在洛杉矶举办「Pro and tell」活动
content_zh:
苹果 10 月 19 日宣布，将于 10 月 28 日（北京时间 10 月 29 日凌晨 1:00）在洛杉矶举办「Pro and tell」活动，爱范儿也已同步收到活动邀请函，届时将带来第一手报道。

活动预计将带来苹果首款触屏 MacBook Pro 与 iPad 新品。
title_en: Apple Announces 'Pro and Tell' Event for October 28 in Los Angeles
content_en:
Apple has officially announced its upcoming "Pro and Tell" special event, scheduled for October 28 in Los Angeles.

The event is widely expected to unveil Apple's first-ever touchscreen MacBook Pro alongside updated iPad models.

title_zh: 中国手机三季度出货量创 14 年同期新低，华为与苹果份额合计超四成
content_zh:
Counterpoint Research 10 月 19 日发布的初步数据表明，2026 年第三季度中国智能手机出货量同比下降 10%，降至自 2012 年以来的同期最低水平。该机构将市场下滑归因于存储价格上涨带来的物料成本增加，以及供应短缺加剧。

华为以 21.3% 的份额位居第一，出货量同比增长 19%。Counterpoint 认为，季度前期相对稳定的价格，以及畅享、nova 和 Mate 产品线的销售表现支撑了增长；华为自 9 月起涨价，则可能给后续销售带来压力。

苹果以 19.5% 的份额排名第二。报告称，iPhone 18 Pro 系列上市前三周在中国市场的销量，比上一代 Pro 系列同期增长 23.5%；基础款延后发布，也促使部分消费者转向 Pro 机型。这项首发销量数据与全季出货量采用不同统计范围。

两家厂商的份额合计超过四成。Counterpoint 指出，面对零部件涨价，其他安卓厂商正通过增加 Pro Max、推出更低价机型或推迟标准版等方式调整产品组合；消费者延后换机、等待促销或转向翻新机的行为，可能继续压制第四季度需求。
title_en: China Smartphone Shipments Hit 14-Year Q3 Low as Huawei and Apple Dominate Over 40% Market Share
content_en:
China’s smartphone shipments fell 10% year-over-year in the third quarter of 2026, dropping to their lowest Q3 level since 2012, according to preliminary data from Counterpoint Research. The market contraction was largely driven by rising component costs—fueled by surging memory prices—and worsening supply shortages.

Despite the downturn, Huawei claimed the top spot with a 21.3% market share, achieving a 19% year-over-year growth in shipments. Counterpoint attributed this momentum to stable early-quarter pricing and robust sales across Huawei's Enjoy, nova, and Mate product lines, though price increases implemented in September may weigh on upcoming sales.

Apple captured second place with a 19.5% market share, bringing the combined share of the two tech giants to over 40%. Sales of the iPhone 18 Pro series surged 23.5% in China during its first three weeks compared to the previous generation's launch period, driven in part by consumers shifting to Pro models amid delayed releases for base versions. Counterpoint noted that cautious consumer spending and prolonged upgrade cycles could continue to dampen Q4 demand.

title_zh: 豆包刘星回应「国内过半算力造爽剧」：字节约 10% 用于视频模型
content_zh:
10 月 19 日，豆包公关负责人刘星回应「国内超一半算力在造爽剧」的说法，称相关算力数据「有些不靠谱」。他表示，字节跳动总算力中，只有约 10% 用于视频生成模型的训练和推理。

红星新闻刊出的刘星原帖截图显示，他同时在流传的两张报道截图上标注了「不实」。这些截图援引一份投资者关系活动记录，将短剧与视频生成列为 AI Token 消耗最大的场景。

刘星给出的比例以字节总算力为范围，同时包含模型训练和推理，并未把这部分算力全部归为短剧制作。
title_en: ByteDance Refutes Claims That Most AI Computing Power Goes to Short Dramas
content_en:
Liu Xing, head of public relations for ByteDance's AI application Doubao, has dismissed reports claiming that over half of China's AI computing power is dedicated to producing short dramas, calling the figures "unreliable."

Liu clarified that ByteDance allocates only about 10% of its total computing capacity to video generation models. He noted that this figure covers both model training and inference across all video generation tasks, rather than being exclusive to short drama production.

Addressing widely circulated media screenshots that cited investor relations records identifying short dramas as the top consumers of AI tokens, Liu publicly flagged the claims as "untrue."

title_zh: 引望与宁德时代签署换电合作协议，覆盖电池与换电网络
content_zh:
10 月 19 日，智能汽车技术企业引望与宁德时代、时代电服签署战略合作框架协议。

三方提出打造面向自动驾驶时代的无感补能体验。路透社援引相关声明报道，合作范围包括可更换电池及换电网络。

据华尔街见闻对签约消息的报道，三方将围绕智能换电生态开展合作，引望正式加入宁德时代巧克力换电生态。宁德时代董事长曾毓群、引望 CEO 靳玉志及宁德时代市场体系联席总裁杨峻等出席签约。
title_en: Yinwang Joins CATL's Battery-Swapping Ecosystem for Autonomous Driving
content_en:
Smart vehicle technology enterprise Yinwang signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement with CATL and its battery-swapping arm, CAES, on October 19.

Under the partnership, Yinwang officially joins CATL's EVOGO ("Chocolate") battery-swapping ecosystem. The three companies plan to build a seamless, automated energy replenishment experience tailored for the autonomous driving era, spanning swappable batteries and battery-swap network infrastructure.

The signing ceremony was attended by key executives, including CATL Chairman Robin Zeng, Yinwang CEO Jin Yuzhi, and CATL Co-President of Marketing Yang Jun.

title_zh: Nscale 与 Anthropic 洽谈 450 亿美元新算力交易，涉及第二座 Monarch 设施
content_zh:
据路透社 10 月 19 日报道，Nscale 正与 Anthropic 商谈一笔可能价值约 450 亿美元的 AI 算力交易，拟由美国西弗吉尼亚州 Monarch 数据中心园区的第二座设施提供服务。

知情人士称，这座设施将采用英伟达 Vera Rubin AI 芯片，提供 460 兆瓦算力。Anthropic 还持有园区计划建设的第三座设施的优先购买权；谈判仍在进行，条款可能变化。

这将是双方在 Monarch 的另一笔合作。今年 8 月，Anthropic 已达成一项价值 450 亿美元的算力租赁协议，本次商谈针对第二座设施，不能与此前协议视为同一笔交易。

路透社同时提到，微软近期因电力接入延误退出了 Nscale 的另一项旗舰数据中心合作，该项目预计供电时间已被推迟至 2030 年代。
title_en: Nscale in Talks with Anthropic for New $45B AI Compute Deal
content_en:
Nscale is negotiating a new AI computing deal valued at approximately $45 billion with Anthropic, Reuters reported on October 19. The proposed arrangement would be hosted at a second facility within the Monarch Data Center campus in West Virginia.

Sources indicate the facility will feature Nvidia's upcoming Vera Rubin AI chips, delivering 460 megawatts of computing power. Anthropic also holds a right of first refusal for a third planned facility at the site, though negotiations remain ongoing and terms may shift.

This negotiation is separate from the $45 billion computing lease agreement signed by the two companies in August for Monarch's first facility. Meanwhile, grid connectivity delays continue to impact data center developers; Microsoft recently withdrew from another major Nscale project after power delivery was pushed into the 2030s.

title_zh: Netflix 电影负责人 Dan Lin 离职
content_zh:
据 Deadline 10 月 19 日报道，Netflix 电影业务负责人 Dan Lin 已离职。Netflix 联席 CEO Ted Sarandos 与 Lin 均向媒体提供了声明，确认这一变动。

Lin 于 2024 年接替 Scott Stuber，进入 Netflix 前经营制片公司 Rideback。他在任期间推动减少高成本电影项目。Sarandos 在声明中感谢他对电影质量、交易策略及团队协作的贡献；Lin 则感谢团队、创作者和管理层。

据知情人士透露，继任者将等 Peter Rice 到任后再决定。Rice 将于 10 月 26 日接替 Bela Bajaria，出任 Netflix 首席内容官。此前电影部门另一名高管 Doug Belgrad 也已离开。

这轮变动发生在 Netflix 调整内容管理层之际。Deadline 称，目前尚未启动 Lin 继任者的面试程序。
title_en: Netflix Film Chief Dan Lin Steps Down Amid Content Leadership Shakeup
content_en:
Netflix film chief Dan Lin has departed the company, according to a report by Deadline on October 19. Both Netflix Co-CEO Ted Sarandos and Lin confirmed the executive change in official statements.

Lin took over the film division in early 2024, succeeding Scott Stuber after leading his production company, Rideback. During his brief tenure, Lin focused on reining in high-budget projects and refining deal strategies. His exit follows the recent departure of another senior film executive, Doug Belgrad.

No replacement has been selected, and interviews have not yet begun. Sources say the decision will be handled by Peter Rice, who is set to replace Bela Bajaria as Chief Content Officer on October 26 as part of a broader management restructuring.

title_zh: 李想：车企与电池供应商要「两条腿交替前进」
content_zh:
10 月 19 日，理想汽车 CEO 李想发文表示，汽车主机厂深入研究电池核心技术，有利于行业发展和消费者利益。

他以个人电脑行业为例：苹果坚持自研操作系统，后来推出 M 系列芯片，软硬件打通后，Mac 的流畅度、续航和散热都有提升；与此同时，微软、英特尔和 AMD 等专业供应商也与电脑厂商一起推动 Windows 电脑进步。

李想认为，超大规模产业需要两类企业协作：深入理解产品的专业供应商，以及深入研究核心技术的整机厂商。长期只依靠一方，行业容易陷入规模竞争，用户在意的性能、质量、安全和寿命反而停滞。

谈到理想自身，他表示，公司在 2020 年决定自研电池，希望从整车和用户需求出发，与合作伙伴一起推进技术。他强调，哪些环节自己做、哪些与伙伴合作，是不同阶段的选择，判断标准是哪种方式对用户更好。

理想 Power Day 电动技术发布会定于 10 月 20 日 19:30 举行。
title_en: Li Auto CEO Advocates Dual-Track Strategy for EV Battery Innovation
content_en:
Li Auto CEO Li Xiang has emphasized that automaker involvement in core battery technology research is essential for industry growth and consumer benefits, advocating for a collaborative "dual-track" approach between OEMs and specialized battery suppliers.

Drawing parallels to the PC industry, Li highlighted how Apple's proprietary OS and M-series chips boosted Mac performance alongside traditional supplier-driven Windows ecosystems. He argued that relying solely on suppliers risks turning the EV industry into a price-and-scale war, while stalling progress in performance, safety, and lifespan.

Li Auto began developing its own battery technology in 2020 to better align hardware with user needs. Li noted that deciding whether to build in-house or partner depends on the company's growth stage, with user value remaining the ultimate benchmark.

title_zh: 斯巴鲁拟统一电子架构，将整车开发周期缩短约 40%
content_zh:
据路透社报道，斯巴鲁在日本佐野市研发中心举行战略说明会，计划在本十年后半段推出软件定义汽车，并将整车开发周期缩短约 40%。

斯巴鲁将逐步在全系车型部署新开发的集成电子控制单元（ECU），核心芯片由其与 AMD 联合开发。纯电、混动和燃油车型将采用统一的电子平台架构，目标是通过 OTA 升级驾驶辅助、自动驾驶和整车性能相关功能。

研发流程也将调整：在原型开发阶段使用数字仿真，并行开展设计、测试与生产准备，以加快新车投放。斯巴鲁同时表示，目前没有采用丰田 Arene 软件平台的计划。
title_en: Subaru to Cut Vehicle Development Time by 40% via Unified Electronic Architecture
content_en:
Subaru plans to launch software-defined vehicles (SDVs) in the second half of this decade and reduce its vehicle development cycle by approximately 40%, the automaker announced during a strategic briefing at its Sano R&D center in Japan.

The strategy centers on deploying a unified electronic platform across all future electric, hybrid, and internal combustion engine models. Powered by an integrated ECU co-developed with AMD, this architecture will support over-the-air (OTA) updates for driver assistance, autonomous driving, and vehicle performance.

To accelerate time-to-market, Subaru is streamlining R&D by integrating digital simulations during prototyping and running design, testing, and production setup concurrently. Notably, the company confirmed it currently has no plans to adopt Toyota’s Arene software platform.

title_zh: Tenstorrent 完成 15 亿美元融资，投后估值达 62 亿美元
content_zh:
Tenstorrent 宣布完成 15 亿美元 E 轮融资，投后估值为 62 亿美元。本轮由 Trace Capital 与 Innovation X 领投，参投方包括 ARK Invest、Fidelity、Morgan Stanley、Sandisk 和 Tether Investments 等。

这家由 Jim Keller 领导的 AI 计算公司，将把资金用于大规模部署 Galaxy 服务器，支持开放权重的大语言模型和视频生成模型，并继续推进对外授权的 AI 与 CPU IP 业务。

Tenstorrent 的产品覆盖单张计算卡、工作站、机架、超级集群和定制 IP，配套开源软件栈，既销售计算设备，也向自行设计芯片的客户提供技术授权。Keller 表示，公司希望用同一套架构覆盖不同规模的计算需求。
title_en: Jim Keller’s Tenstorrent Raises $1.5 Billion at $6.2 Billion Valuation
content_en:
AI computing startup Tenstorrent, led by industry veteran Jim Keller, has completed a $1.5 billion Series E funding round, bringing its post-money valuation to $6.2 billion. The round was co-led by Trace Capital and Innovation X, with participation from major investors including Fidelity, Morgan Stanley, ARK Invest, Sandisk, and Tether Investments.

The fresh capital will fund the large-scale deployment of Tenstorrent’s Galaxy servers, designed to run open-weight large language models and video generation models. Additionally, the company plans to expand its core AI and CPU IP licensing operations.

Tenstorrent offers a comprehensive product lineup—ranging from standalone compute cards and workstations to full server racks and custom IP—supported by an open-source software stack. Keller noted that the company's goal is to serve compute requirements across all scales using a unified architecture.

title_zh: 💡 杨立昆锐评特斯拉会飞超跑，马斯克用「放屁」回应质疑
content_zh:
昨天，埃隆·马斯克在 X 上发文称：「我朝你大致的方向放了个屁 💨」，回应 Yann LeCun 此前对其「会飞的汽车」相关演示的质疑。

LeCun 随后以「高压腹部」为比喻，调侃称这种「放屁」或许能让人向上、向前推进，并将汽车的推进原理类比为一个压力达 700 bar、容量 600 升、持续 3 秒的「响屁」。

这场互动源于马斯克此前发布的一段视频。他表示，未来确实会出现飞行汽车。

LeCun 则认为，视频中的车辆依靠压缩空气推进，虽然可能在短时间内提供不同方向的加速度，甚至在用一个 400 升高压储气罐替代乘客座椅的情况下悬浮数秒，但并不能成为真正飞行汽车的技术路径。

LeCun 还称，即使压缩空气占车辆总质量的一半，可用推力时间也可能不足 10 秒，更可能只有约 5 秒。

他表示，自己并不反对马斯克取得的真实成就，甚至拥有两辆特斯拉，但会质疑那些「表面上很酷、实际并非宣传所称成就」的营销演示。

🔗 相关阅读：特斯拉只能飞 5 秒？科学家称其为「放屁车」，联邦航空局：不符合航空器定义
title_en: Yann LeCun and Elon Musk Clash Over Tesla's 'Flying Car' Concepts
content_en:
Elon Musk and Meta's Chief AI Scientist Yann LeCun have engaged in a heated exchange on X regarding Tesla's proposed "flying" supercar technology. The debate began after Musk shared a video asserting that flying cars would eventually become a reality, prompting LeCun to publicly challenge the underlying physics.

LeCun argued that relying on compressed air thrusters to elevate a vehicle is technically impractical. According to his calculations, even if a massive 400-to-600-liter high-pressure air tank replaced the passenger seat and accounted for half the vehicle's total weight, it would yield less than five to ten seconds of thrust—metaphorically comparing the mechanism to a brief, high-pressure burst of air.

Musk responded dismissively on X with a humorous quote: "I fart in your general direction 💨."

Despite the banter, LeCun clarified that he respects Musk's genuine accomplishments and noted that he owns two Tesla vehicles. However, he emphasized the necessity of calling out promotional demonstrations that appear impressive on the surface but lack technical viability as true flying vehicles.

title_zh: 腾讯 WorkBuddy 教育公益版上线，教师每月可领 2000 积分
content_zh:
10 月 19 日，腾讯 SSV 宣布 WorkBuddy 教育公益版正式上线，面向全国教师开放。开通后，每位教师每月可领取 2000 积分，连续支持 12 个月，不限地区和学段。

腾讯 SSV 与 WorkBuddy 团队围绕教师工作制作了 AI 教学助理，并联合北京大学、北京师范大学等高校，将教学设计、公开课打磨、分层教学、家校沟通和学生心理等研究成果转为可调用的教育专家模块，相关模块将陆续上线。

产品还提供创意教学、剧本课堂、课件制作、动画演示和素材加工等工具。教师可以用自然语言描述教学需求，生成初稿后继续修改。后续计划打通腾讯文档、乐享知识库和 ima，把资料库与协同编辑接入工作流。

教师可从「腾讯 SSV」微信公众号菜单进入申领入口，填写身份信息，审核通过后 3 个工作日内开通。积分每月 1 日补满，耗尽后仍可使用免费模型。
title_en: Tencent Launches Free AI Philanthropy Platform for Teachers Nationwide
content_en:
Tencent SSV has officially launched the educational philanthropy edition of WorkBuddy, making the AI platform available to primary, secondary, and higher education teachers across China. Under the initiative, verified educators will receive 2,000 free monthly AI credits for 12 consecutive months.

Developed in partnership with leading institutions like Peking University and Beijing Normal University, the platform integrates expert modules covering lesson design, open-class refining, differentiated instruction, home-school communication, and student psychological support. Teachers can use natural language prompts to auto-generate lesson plans, script interactive classes, design courseware, and process multimedia materials.

Looking ahead, Tencent plans to integrate WorkBuddy into workflow tools such as Tencent Docs and Lexiang Knowledge Base. Teachers can apply via the "Tencent SSV" WeChat official account, with verification completed within three business days. Credits reset on the first of every month, and basic free models remain accessible even after monthly points are exhausted.

title_zh: 商务部：前 9 月重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1.1 倍
content_zh:
10 月 19 日，商务部部长助理袁晓明在国新办新闻发布会上表示，商务大数据显示，今年 1—9 月，重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1.1 倍。这项数据统计的是重点平台的销售金额，未披露全国销量或出货量。

商务部等 9 部门近日发布《关于加快推进科技兴商的意见》，提出丰富智能手机、电脑、家居、穿戴设备和机器人等智能商品供给，拓展商业智能体和具身智能在家庭服务、商贸物流等场景中的应用。

文件还提出培育品质电商，探索「先鉴别、后发货」模式，加强重点产品电商平台联网核查，并推动家电等领域建立人工智能终端智能化分级国家标准。袁晓明表示，政策将科技创新融入从供给、流通到消费的商贸全链条。
title_en: Smart Glasses Sales Jump 110% on Major Chinese E-Commerce Platforms
content_en:
Sales revenue for smart glasses on major e-commerce platforms surged by 110% year-over-year during the first nine months of the year, according to Yuan Xiaoming, Assistant Minister of Commerce, speaking at a State Council Information Office press conference on October 19.

The surge aligns with new policy guidelines jointly issued by nine government departments, including the Ministry of Commerce. The initiative aims to expand the supply of smart consumer products—such as smartphones, PCs, wearables, and robotics—while advancing the deployment of AI agents and embodied AI in household services and commercial logistics.

To support high-quality e-commerce growth, the guidelines also propose an "authentication before dispatch" delivery model and the creation of national grading standards for AI-enabled hardware. Officials highlighted that these measures are designed to seamlessly incorporate tech innovation into every stage of the trade lifecycle, from supply chains to retail consumption.

title_zh: MiniMax M3.1 Flash 上线：推理提速近 3 倍，Agent 任务成本降 70%
content_zh:
MiniMax 正式上线 M3.1 Flash，并确认此前匿名运行、累计处理超过 200T Token 的 Space Bunny「太空兔」是其早期版本。新模型已进入 MiniMax API、MPlan 和 MiniMax Code，权重将在稍后开放。

官方称，M3.1 Flash 的线上推理速度提升近 3 倍，Agent 类任务的综合使用成本较前代降低 70%。每百万 Token 的输入价格为 1 元、输出为 4 元，缓存读取为 0.1 元；日常使用场景输出速度可达每秒 200 Token 以上，中位数稳定在每秒 170 Token 以上。

能力更新主要集中在跨应用自动化、编程、电脑操作和网络安全。按团队公布的评测，模型在 DeepSWE v1.1 中取得 73.7%，OSWorld V2 为 61.7 分，CyberGym 为 82%。MiniMax 同时预告，追求更高能力上限的 Pro 版本也将在稍后推出。
title_en: MiniMax Launches M3.1 Flash: Boosting Inference Speeds 3x and Slashing Agent Task Costs by 70%
content_en:
Chinese AI startup MiniMax has officially launched **M3.1 Flash**, an upgraded model offering significantly improved performance and lower operational costs. The company confirmed that M3.1 Flash is the full release of "Space Bunny," an anonymous test model that previously processed over 200 trillion tokens.

The new model delivers nearly 3x faster inference speeds—exceeding 200 tokens per second in routine scenarios—while reducing overall costs for AI Agent tasks by 70%. Pricing is set at 1 RMB per million input tokens and 4 RMB per million output tokens, with cache reading priced at 0.1 RMB per million tokens.

M3.1 Flash excels in cross-application automation, coding, computer control, and cybersecurity, achieving strong benchmark scores across DeepSWE v1.1 (73.7%), OSWorld V2 (61.7), and CyberGym (82%). The model is currently accessible via the MiniMax API, MPlan, and MiniMax Code, with open weights and a higher-performing "Pro" version scheduled for future release.

title_zh: 《海岛大亨 7》免费 Demo 上线，支持简体中文语音
content_zh:
Kalypso Media 旗下模拟经营系列新作《海岛大亨 7》已在 Steam 开放免费 Demo，支持简体中文界面、语音和字幕。游戏由 Gaming Minds Studios 开发，中文区商店显示计划于 2027 年 1 月 29 日发售。

本作继续让玩家扮演岛屿领袖，经营城市、处理选举和外交，并首次通过地形改造系统抹平山脉、制造沙滩乃至建造新岛屿。议会系统允许玩家召集不同派系谈判，重制后的军事系统则可更直接地指挥部队。

完整游戏包含 5 张战役地图，新增对手维多利亚·格拉，并提供 10 个额外场景、20 多张沙盒地图和随机地图生成器。PC 最低配置要求 16GB 内存、RTX 2060 或 RX 5600 XT 级别显卡，以及 40GB 可用存储空间。
title_en: Tropico 7 Releases Free Steam Demo Featuring Full Chinese Audio Support
content_en:
Publisher Kalypso Media and developer Gaming Minds Studios have released a free PC demo for *Tropico 7* on Steam. The trial includes full Simplified Chinese localization across its interface, subtitles, and voiceover. The full game is currently scheduled for release on January 29, 2027.

*Tropico 7* introduces several new mechanics to the long-running city-builder series, including a dynamic terrain modification tool that lets players flatten mountains, create custom beaches, and build brand-new islands. Additional enhancements include a Parliament system to negotiate with political factions and a revamped military system providing direct command over troops.

The complete release will feature 5 campaign maps, a new rival named Victoria Guerra, over 20 sandbox maps, and a random map generator. Minimum PC system requirements include 16GB RAM, an NVIDIA RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5600 XT graphics card, and 40GB of available storage space.

title_zh: 中国电信开源 Xing4.0-29B-Intent，把口语指令转为结构化信息
content_zh:
中电信人工智能科技有限公司星辰通用人工智能实验室发布并开源 Xing4.0-29B-Intent，提供模型权重、代码和约 275 万条训练语料。模型基于 29B 的混合专家架构，激活参数约 4B，面向意图识别和结构化信息抽取。

它会按照开发者给定的类别与字段规则，将自然语言转成 JSON。例如「帮我查明天北京到上海的航班」，输出既要识别查询航班的意图，也要抽取出发地、目的地和日期。模型还支持一句话中的多个意图和多个参数。

同一套「类别＋参数」格式覆盖意图理解、实体识别、关系抽取与事件抽取。配套数据集覆盖 61 个公开数据集、19 个领域和 52 种语言；官方同时提供 Python SDK，支持接入兼容 OpenAI API 的模型服务。

项目代码、权重和公开数据采用 Apache 2.0 许可。官方介绍，模型已用于电信万号客服的意图识别、工单路由及智能家居音箱指令解析。
title_en: China Telecom Open-Sources Xing4.0-29B-Intent for Natural Language Data Extraction
content_en:
China Telecom AI Tech's Xingchen Laboratory has open-sourced **Xing4.0-29B-Intent**, a specialized AI model designed to convert natural language commands into structured JSON data. Released under the Apache 2.0 license, the package includes model weights, source code, and a dataset containing approximately 2.75 million training samples.

Built on a 29-billion parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with roughly 4 billion active parameters, the model unifies intent recognition, entity extraction, relation mapping, and event detection. It is optimized to process complex, multi-intent prompts and parameters within a single command.

The underlying training corpus spans 61 public datasets across 19 domains and 52 languages. Accompanied by a Python SDK compatible with OpenAI API standards, the model has already been deployed commercially across China Telecom's customer service systems, ticket routing operations, and smart home devices.

title_zh: EFF 将 Privacy Badger 带到 Mac 版 Safari，可阻止隐藏追踪器加载
content_zh:
电子前哨基金会（EFF）10 月 19 日宣布，反追踪扩展 Privacy Badger 已登陆 macOS 上的 Safari，免费提供，要求 Safari 26.5 或更高版本。

EFF 表示，Safari 默认会限制追踪器能够获取的信息，但仍允许它们加载；Privacy Badger 则会直接阻止识别出的在线追踪器加载，补充浏览器已有的隐私保护。扩展会自动学习识别隐藏追踪器，以减少数据经纪商和广告技术公司跨站收集用户信息。

Privacy Badger 此前已支持 Chrome、Edge 和 Firefox。EFF 称，Safari 是用户长期要求支持的平台之一，此次上线后，这款工具已覆盖主要桌面浏览器；所有平台的用户总数超过 400 万。
title_en: EFF Brings Privacy Badger Extension to Mac Safari to Block Hidden Trackers
content_en:
The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) has officially launched its anti-tracking browser extension, Privacy Badger, for Safari on macOS. The free extension is now available for users running Safari version 26.5 or higher.

While Safari natively limits the amount of information trackers can collect, it still allows them to load. Privacy Badger complements these built-in protections by automatically detecting and blocking hidden trackers entirely, helping prevent data brokers and ad-tech firms from profiling users across the web.

With this release, Privacy Badger now covers all major desktop browsers, including Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, serving a combined global user base of over 4 million.

title_zh: 星巴克中国否认「消费才可入座」，部分门店拟摆提示牌
content_zh:
针对「星巴克将于 10 月 20 日实施消费才可入座」的消息，星巴克中国向蓝鲸新闻回应称：「不属实。」

这次讨论源于社交平台流传的《星巴克「第三空间」倡议》物料及「请消费入座」桌牌。九派新闻走访门店时，有店员称收到了新规则，建议顾客消费后使用座位，但不会一刀切；孕妇、外卖员、避雨路人等有临时需求者仍可短暂休息，并可获得热水。

界面新闻记者询问北京东四环一家门店，店员也表示已收到桌牌，计划 10 月 20 日摆放；另一位店员称，座位客满时可能提醒无故长时间占座的人，普通短暂休息、等人无需被强制要求买咖啡。
title_en: Starbucks China Denies Strict 'Purchase Required for Seating' Rumors
content_en:
Starbucks China has dismissed recent online rumors claiming that customers will be required to make a purchase before sitting down starting October 20. The discussion arose after photos of proposed tabletop signs encouraging customer purchases circulated on social media.

Store employees confirmed that while new advisory signs are being introduced, the policy will not be enforced rigidly. Individuals with brief, essential needs—such as pregnant women, delivery drivers, and people seeking shelter from the rain—are still welcome to take short breaks and request free hot water.

Staff noted that baristas will only consider intervening if non-paying guests occupy seats for extended periods when the store is fully occupied.

title_zh: 汇源集团停产带「汇源」商标的果汁，启用「咱家果源」
content_zh:
10 月 19 日，北京汇源饮料食品集团有限公司发布声明，并向上海证券报记者确认，集团及下属企业将停止生产、代工带有「汇源」商标的果汁产品，终止相关代工合同，改由新品牌「咱家果源」承接业务。

这次调整涉及汇源集团与重整后的北京汇源食品饮料有限公司之间的品牌及经营关系。

汇源集团称，因重整投资人上海文盛未履行约定，北京汇源已事实上脱离集团全产业链体系，集团将继续推进相关法律程序。

汇源集团表示，自己仍持有果园、生产基地及供应链等实业资产，新品牌将依托这些资源继续经营果汁业务。
title_en: Huiyuan Group Ceases 'Huiyuan' Trademark Juice Production, Launches New Brand
content_en:
Beijing Huiyuan Beverage & Food Group has announced that it will stop manufacturing and contract-producing juice products under the iconic "Huiyuan" trademark. The group is terminating related OEM contracts and transitioning its core business to a new brand named "Zanjia Guoyuan."

This major shift follows complex restructuring disputes. The group stated that due to a breach of agreement by restructuring investor Shanghai Wensheng, its former operating unit, Beijing Huiyuan, has effectively detached from the group's supply chain system. Legal proceedings regarding the matter are ongoing.

Huiyuan Group emphasized that it still owns its underlying physical assets, including orchards, manufacturing bases, and supply chain infrastructure, which will fully support the operations of the new juice brand.

title_zh: 延尚昊新片《Paradise Lost》售至 118 个市场，韩国 10 月 21 日上映
content_zh:
据 Deadline 报道，《釜山行》导演延尚昊执导的心理惊悚片《Paradise Lost》已售至 118 个国家和地区，并将在夏威夷国际电影节举行美国首映。

影片由金贤珠、裴贤圣主演，讲述一位母亲在儿子失踪九年后，等到他突然生还的故事。当年，一辆载着孩子前往营地的巴士神秘消失，母亲早已认定儿子死亡。

影片此前在多伦多和釜山电影节放映，夏威夷场次定于 11 月 1 日和 4 日。发行方 CJ ENM 称，海外销售收入已超过影片的净制作预算。日本、法国和北美发行权分别由 Twin、The Jokers Films 和 Well Go USA 取得。

《Paradise Lost》将于 10 月 21 日在韩国上映，10 月 23 日登陆中国台湾，11 月 5 日在新加坡上映，北美档期为 11 月 6 日。
title_en: Yeon Sang-ho’s Thriller 'Paradise Lost' Lands Distribution in 118 Markets Ahead of Korean Debut
content_en:
*Paradise Lost*, a new psychological thriller directed by *Train to Busan* filmmaker Yeon Sang-ho, has secured distribution deals across 118 global markets. Distributor CJ ENM confirmed that pre-sales revenue from overseas markets has already surpassed the film's net production budget. Key international rights holders include Well Go USA for North America, Twin for Japan, and The Jokers Films for France.

Starring Kim Hyun-joo and Bae Hyun-sung, the film centers on a grieving mother whose son unexpectedly reappears nine years after a summer camp bus mysteriously vanished—a tragedy that had led her to assume he was dead. Following festival screenings in Toronto and Busan, the film will hold its U.S. premiere at the Hawaii International Film Festival in early November.

*Paradise Lost* is scheduled for theatrical release in South Korea on October 21, followed by rollouts in Taiwan on October 23, Singapore on November 5, and North America on November 6.

title_zh: 《足球教练》主创愿拍第 5、6 季，编剧室尚未启动
content_zh:
《足球教练》（Ted Lasso）第 4 季本月结束后，主创兼主演杰森·苏戴奇斯在播客《Talk Easy with Sam Fragoso》中谈到了继续拍摄的可能。

主持人问他是否已有第 5、6 季的规划，他表示，决定重返第 4 季时，确实觉得这个故事还有内容可讲，但后续需要团队共同完成。当被直接问到是否愿意继续，他回答：「我愿意，我觉得会很有趣。」

苏戴奇斯同时明确表示，目前还不知道后续是否会成行，团队尚未成立编剧室。他推测，如果自己决定继续，Apple 应该也愿意合作。

9to5Mac 10 月 19 日刊出了这段对话。苏戴奇斯的表态透露出继续创作的意愿，但没有宣布续订，也没有给出下一季的制作或上线日期。
title_en: Jason Sudeikis Open to 'Ted Lasso' Seasons 5 and 6, Writers' Room Yet to Open
content_en:
*Ted Lasso* co-creator and star Jason Sudeikis has expressed willingness to continue the beloved comedy series beyond its fourth season, though formal development has not yet begun. Speaking on the *Talk Easy with Sam Fragoso* podcast, Sudeikis revealed that he would be open to crafting fifth and sixth seasons if the creative team aligns.

"I am, I think it'd be fun," Sudeikis remarked when asked directly about extending the show's run. He explained that during discussions for Season 4, he realized there was still compelling story left to explore, though he emphasized that any future seasons would require a collaborative effort from the whole team.

Despite his enthusiasm, Sudeikis clarified that a writers' room has not been established and no official renewal or release dates have been set. However, he expressed confidence that Apple would be eager to support additional seasons if he and his team decide to move forward.

title_zh: 乔恩·斯图尔特续约《每日秀》至 2028 年，继续轮值主持与执行制片
content_zh:
据 Variety 10 月 19 日报道，乔恩·斯图尔特与 Comedy Central 续签两年合约，将继续参与《每日秀》至 2028 年，覆盖下一届美国总统大选周期。他上一份合约原定于今年年底到期。

续约后，斯图尔特继续与 Ronny Chieng、Josh Johnson、Jordan Klepper、Michael Kosta 和 Desi Lydic 等人轮值主持，同时担任执行制片人，与节目统筹 Jen Flanz 及长期经纪人 James Dixon 合作。

斯图尔特自 1999 年开始主持这档讽刺新闻节目，2015 年离开，2024 年 2 月回归。其间主持棒曾交给 Trevor Noah。

按照派拉蒙提供的数据，《每日秀》是 2026 年社交媒体上观看量最高的有线电视节目。此次续约发生在派拉蒙与华纳兄弟完成合并数周后，节目继续保留轮值主持阵容。
title_en: Jon Stewart Renews 'The Daily Show' Deal Through 2028 Election Cycle
content_en:
Jon Stewart has signed a two-year contract extension with Comedy Central to remain on *The Daily Show* through 2028. The deal ensures Stewart will stay on board through the next U.S. presidential election cycle, extending his previous contract that was scheduled to expire at the end of this year.

Under the renewed agreement, Stewart will continue to host on a rotating basis alongside correspondents Ronny Chieng, Josh Johnson, Jordan Klepper, Michael Kosta, and Desi Lydic. He will also retain his role as executive producer alongside showrunner Jen Flanz and longtime manager James Dixon.

Stewart, who originally led the satirical news program from 1999 to 2015, returned to the show in February 2024. According to Paramount data, *The Daily Show* currently ranks as the most-watched cable show on social media, underscoring the strong impact of Stewart's return.
